summary: Add bounded indexed mission run queries with fractal missions runs --mission-prefix

schema.detail: Store open installs a prefix-reader-scoped partial index on non-terminal mission runs by mission ID and run ordering, replacing the earlier preview index if present. Existing stores build this index once synchronously, not online; large-store installation duration is unmeasured. No claim schema changes or projection replay.

rules.detail: No mission execution or authorization rules change.

compatibility.detail: Adds read-only GET /v1/client/mission-runs and fractal missions runs --mission-prefix PREFIX [--active] [--limit N] [--json]. Limits default to 100 runs and permit at most 500, with at most 500 steps per run. The client envelope preserves snapshot metadata and reports run and step truncation explicitly; absent optional data is omitted.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart includes synchronous first-open index construction; large-store installation duration is unmeasured.

manual.detail: No operator action required. Narrow the mission prefix or increase --limit when results are truncated; inspect an individual run for additional steps.

recovery.detail: Read-only query; no recovery action required.
